regions.merged_text: 4 - you and yours. And may the peace of the saints be ours, here and beyond the hopeful borders of this solemn pilgrimage - afterall but a momentary "vestibule to eternal realities". For the severalth time I am starting again a response to your pathetic plaint of April 24th. I do hope this finds you in every way as healthy and hopeful as it leaves us all here at the Friary. Deo Gr. How wonderful, even tho' full of mystery at every turn, are not His - God's own - works and ways! always in the final - never failing in the turning to the Glory of God and the happiness of the faithful, the appreciative, the grateful, and true. History abounds with examples most telling of this happy contention; mediaeval and modern as well as . nay, infinitely surpassing anything- in the ancient world, for real, "excelsior chivalry" and for inspiring loyalty to faith and eternal principle; - divine appreciation, remeration always infinit- ely in the leade. Beautifully romantic and hope-inspiring at once are always the examples of humble confidence, of unhesitationg obedience to God and authority, of persevering loyalty in the face of contradic- tion to faith and principles of RELIGION, -after all and in reality the only science that gives purpose to every other science, "The Science of our happy dependence on God and our neighbor." Or; if you will: "Religion, the Science of our happy relationship with and our providential depencence on God and our neighbor. Hopeful borders of this solemn pilgrimage
